title: Krusha families protest Court of Appeals sentence reduction outside Palace of Justice
location: Outside Palace of Justice / Court of Appeals, Pristina
crowd_size: “Several tens” of family representatives in RTS account; exact attendance unknown
crowd_size_evidence: RTS reports several tens of family representatives; BIRN mentions relatives of dozens of victims but does not count participants. At least 50 not established.

occurrence_and_date.value: BIRN, RTS and Lajmi.net report the protest on Dec 3.

location.value: Palace of Justice / seat of Court of Appeals, Pristina.

attendance.value: RTS reports several tens of family representatives; BIRN mentions relatives of dozens of victims but does not count participants. At least 50 not established.

state_targeted_demand.value: Protesters challenge the domestic Court of Appeals decision halving a war-crimes sentence and demand justice.

episode_and_continuity.value: One Dec 3 event after the Dec 1 appeal decision; later requests to retry/reporting do not prove a continuing public gathering. Adjacent-month event continuity remains unverified.

source_dependence.value: Balkan Insight and Prishtina Insight identify BIRN as publisher; their records are not independent. RTS is a separate newsroom; Lajmi.net has separate outlet identity.

decision_note: Multiple contemporaneous reports document a public gathering demanding justice after the Kosovo Court of Appeals halved Darko Tasic’s sentence. RTS describes several tens of family representatives, not a verified count of 50+; BIRN and Prishtina Insight may share a written origin, so their accounts are not assumed independent.

title: Cystic Fibrosis Association and parents protest lack of essential medicines
location: Outside the Ministry of Health, Pristina
crowd_size_evidence: Association and parents mentioned; no number or 50+ qualitative threshold.

occurrence_and_date.value: Klan Kosova article is dated Dec 7 and states the protest occurred; KosovaPress independently reports the protest without a visible date in rendered body.

location.value: Outside Kosovo Ministry of Health, Pristina.

attendance.value: Association and parents mentioned; no number or 50+ qualitative threshold.

state_targeted_demand.value: Demand for Ministry of Health to resolve lack of essential medicines and staff for cystic fibrosis patients.

episode_and_continuity.value: One Dec 7 protest documented; no follow-up/adjacent-month same-campaign gathering established.

source_dependence.value: Two local publishers report the event, but shared written origin has not been established; KOHA and GazetaExpress exact attempts were blocked.

decision_note: KosovaPress and Klan Kosova report the Association and parents protested outside the Ministry; the accessible reports give no attendance. The protest date is supported by Klan’s dated page and the contemporaneous article/result date; source relationship with KosovaPress remains unestablished.

title: Private-sector hospital technical staff strike over additional payments (public gathering unverified)
location: Multiple clinical centres reportedly joined a strike; no single public gathering site documented
crowd_size_evidence: Around/over 2,000 workers on strike across workplaces; not a count at a single simultaneous public gathering.

occurrence_and_date.value: Reports dated Dec 13/14 say the strike began Dec 14.

location.value: Multiple hospitals/clinical centres across Kosovo; no common gathering site reported.

attendance.value: Around/over 2,000 workers on strike across workplaces; not a count at a single simultaneous public gathering.

state_targeted_demand.value: Union asks the Kosovo Government to grant additional health-sector payments; private contractors employed the technical staff and their treatment under subsidy rules is relevant.

episode_and_continuity.value: Work stoppage across multiple locations, not merged into a single street event; distinct public assembly remains unverified.

decision_note: TV Prizreni and Exit report over 2,000 technical workers on strike across hospitals/clinical centres and a demand that Government provide additional payments. These reports document distributed workplace stoppage, not >=50 people assembling together at a public site. No qualifying gathering is inferred; seek a distinct report if a separate public protest occurred.
